newsitem.title: CANADA: Canada's Prairies to see snow west, cool weather.
newsitem.headline: Canada's Prairies to see snow west, cool weather.

text.p: Canada's Prairies were forecast to see snow in Alberta's Peace River Valley and cool temperatures throughout the region, Environment Canada said.

"We've got a system coming through Alberta today bringing a mix of rain and snow and as it moves out over the Prairies the system weakens, it'll reach northern Manitoba by Friday," meteorologist Rick Walls said.
Alberta should see highs of 0 to 9.0 Celsius with freezing rain or snow. Grand Prairie, in the Peace River Valley, should see 4 cms (1.6 inches). Harvest was 80 percent complete.
Saskatchewan should see clouds, highs of 0 to 10 Celsius.
Manitoba should see mainly sunny skies with highs of 0 to 8.0 Celsius. Manitoba's harvest was 100 percent complete.
